title: Man and Machine
coreMove: Split a workflow so computers handle pattern-heavy work and people handle judgment-rich calls.
sourcePressure: The chapter frames technology as complementing human work when machines and people do different jobs well, not as a simple replacement story. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the chapter into automation panic or technological cheerleading.
